titolo: Le Figaro teams up with OpenAI to embed its journalism in ChatGPT
descr: Le Groupe Figaro will provide summaries, excerpts and links to its articles within ChatGPT, expanding the news source for users.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced a partnership with Le Groupe Figaro on 2026-11-18.
The collaboration will integrate Le Figaro's journalism into ChatGPT as summaries and excerpts.
Each excerpt will include a link to the original story, allowing users to access full articles.
The move aims to broaden the range of news content available through the AI chat service.
Both organisations highlighted the benefit of delivering reliable journalism directly within the chat experience.
perche: For those seeking free or locally hosted models, the partnership underscores how large AI platforms can enrich their offerings with licensed media, a feature less common in open-source alternatives.
